html: דרג (√ of foll. cf. Arabic دَرَجَ go on foot, step bt step, walk, دَرِجَ rise in grade, rank; NH דרג Hiph. raise, make high; Eth; ደርገ is be connected; Aramaic ܕܰܪܶܓ (verb denom. according to PS); also Assyrian darâgu, be high, lift, Lyon Sargontexte 80, durgu, daragu, path, way (of steep mountain paths) COTGloss (cf. also דרך); Arabic دَرَجَةٌ a step, stair, Aramaic דַּרְגָּא, ܕܪܶܓ, ܕܰܪܓܳܐ id.)
